projects.title: JourneyMesh - Multi-Agent AI Travel Planner (LangGraph + MCP + LLMOps)
projects.summary: Supervisor-routed multi-agent travel planning with guardrails, evaluation and human review
projects.problem: Turn a free-text trip request into a trustworthy, editable travel plan without hallucinated prices or flights, without running agents a request does not need, and without leaking PII or letting a model act unchecked.
projects.approach: A LangGraph supervisor routes each request to only the specialist agents it needs (flight, hotel, weather, budget, itinerary). Every external call passes an MCP tool guard; input and output guardrails screen prompt injection, unlawful intent and PII; a ten-dimension evaluator scores each draft; a human approves or requests changes, and only the affected agents re-run. State is checkpointed in PostgreSQL, traced with structured logs and optional LangSmith, and shipped as one Docker image through GitHub Actions to an OVHcloud VPS.
projects.outcome: Deployed live with an open-source codebase covered by 218 backend tests, 21 frontend tests and an offline evaluation suite gated in CI.
